title: RAID EVENTS: OVERSEER RAMPAGE
why: The sixth and last raid event, the Overseer rampage: the boss leaves its lair and sweeps the map. With the Overseer alive, a 12 second warning puts a ring on it, then for two minutes it is off its leash and 60 percent faster. It walks to three points in three different quarters of the map and then comes for you wherever you are, by the street grid, firing and using its phases as ever. The ring and the map mark follow it. When the two minutes are up, or it dies, it goes back to being the guardian of its lair. DEMO and CAREER work the same.
now: The Overseer rampage event: the boss leaves its lair for two minutes and sweeps the map, then comes for you.
